items.answer: A limited budget works best when the trade-offs are chosen deliberately. Normalise unit size, location, condition, payment timing and included features before deciding that one option offers a better entry price.
items.question: How do I buy with a limited budget?

items.answer: A mortgage may be possible, but eligibility depends on both the buyer and property. Confirm that the specific property, project status and valuation can support the mortgage route being considered by the buyer.
items.question: Can I get a mortgage?

items.answer: A payment plan can fail when later instalments, project timing or buyer cash flow do not align. Review late-payment consequences, cancellation, assignment and other contract provisions before treating a low initial payment as low risk.
items.question: What can go wrong with a payment plan?

items.answer: Dubai property ownership is not the same as having no taxes, fees or financial obligations. A marketing phrase is replacing a proper review of transaction charges and buyer-specific obligations. Confirm the current treatment with official and professional sources before relying on a tax outcome.
